name: onboarding_step_completed
description: A person finished one step of an onboarding flow. Drives step conversion, drop-off localization, and latency by step.
trigger: The step’s success condition is met — the form validated, the resource was created, the permission was granted.
nonTriggers: Do not fire when the step is merely displayed; display is not completion.
Do not fire when the person skips the step — a skipped step is not a completed one, and conflating them inflates conversion.
Do not fire again on a step the person revisits and re-submits without changing anything.

properties.name: flow_id
properties.description: Stable identifier of the onboarding flow, e.g. initial_setup. A flow, not a flow run.

properties.name: step_id
properties.description: Stable identifier of the step, e.g. invite_team. Never a display label.

properties.name: step_number
properties.description: Position of the step within the flow, starting at 1. Ordering the funnel by step_id alone is not possible.

properties.name: duration_ms
properties.description: Milliseconds from the step being presented to it completing.
